plan.output: A reviewable product description and a note saying whether the supplied message and image were both used.
plan.trigger: An operator submits one fictional message paired with one synthetic image.
steps: Pair the message with its existing image in one test record.
Send both inputs to a vision model in a sandbox.
Ask for a short product description and uncertainty note.
Compare the output with a hand-written expected category.
Record whether the test incorrectly asks for the image again.
plan.acceptanceCheck: For each of five fictional message-image pairs, compare the result with the expected category and flag any request to resend an image.
plan.humanBoundary: An operator supplies synthetic examples, checks image rights, reviews every output, and handles real customer conversations manually.

plan.output: A draft wireframe or illustration generated from a supplied rough sketch, with an editable review copy.
plan.trigger: A designer uploads one synthetic sketch and selects wireframe or illustration.
steps: Prepare five fictional rough sketches with expected key elements.
Submit each sketch and style instruction to a chosen image-generation tool.
Save the generated draft beside its input.
Compare whether key elements remain recognizable.
Have a designer mark corrections before reuse.
plan.acceptanceCheck: Check that each draft retains the expected screen regions and labels, then record whether a designer accepts it after edits.
plan.humanBoundary: A designer supplies sketches, checks rights and edits every draft; no generated artwork is delivered without review.
